label:
Whey protein
isolate
step: filter and diafilter, or ion exchange

about.text: Whey protein separated from whey by microfiltration or ion exchange, a route parallel to whey protein concentrate, to more than 90 % protein in its dry matter, with almost no fat or lactose left. Used in sports and clinical nutrition.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Whey processing

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Isolate is made from defatted, clarified whey, not from finished concentrate: ultrafiltration and diafiltration (often after microfiltration) wash out lactose and minerals, or ion exchange binds the protein and releases it again. Skim milk can also be microfiltered to give native whey, which is then ultrafiltered.
